outputs.video_spec: 1920x1080, 30 fps, 10 s (300 frames), real speed (no slow motion), H.264 yuv420p bt709 CRF 16, the clip's own AAC audio
outputs.still_spec: 3840x2160 px, 300 dpi, clip frame 206 (t = 6.87 s), trail = every tracked position of frames 187-206 (one shot)

on_screen.counter_animation: counts up 0 -> 89 over 0.3-1.1 s, then fixed
on_screen.attribution: Tennis footage: "Tennis Players Playing Match" by Gelato Prod, Pexels (Pexels License)
on_screen.type: Inter 500 22 px white (counter, counts up 0 -> final during the fade-in); Inter 400 15 px grey #aeaeb2 (model line, two-line attribution); right-aligned at x = 1766 (8% margin), baselines y = 530, 556, 580, 600, over the dark windscreen right of the court; soft dark halo under the type; fades in 0.15-0.75 s
on_screen.no_call: no in/out call, no landing point, no speed or spin readout

what_is_drawn.trail: our tracked ball positions (tennis_detections.json ball_xy) of the last 10 frames (0.33 s), #FF6B1A fading with age and whitening towards the newest point; consecutive detections are joined only if at most 3 frames apart; frames without a detection draw no ring and add no point
what_is_drawn.ring: thin #FF6B1A ring (r = 9 px) around the ball in frames where it was tracked
what_is_drawn.court_lines: the nine painted court lines projected with that frame's court_H; each draws in along its length from 0.1 s (white 70%, 3 px), then settles by 1.6 s to white 30%, 1.5 px for the rest of the clip
what_is_drawn.vignette: subtle radial vignette, corners down to -20% brightness
